sceneConcept: A thin twenty-seven-year-old Chinese online community administrator stands alone against a transparent background with an intentionally forgettable presence. Slightly messy dark-brown hair, pale skin, grey eyes and a blank quiet face reveal little. He wears an oversized grey hoodie beneath a washed navy jacket, straight black trousers and plain grey sneakers. Large completely unmarked noise-cancelling headphones cover his ears; one hand holds a plain dark smartphone low near his waist while the other remains in a jacket pocket, and his attention drifts down toward the device. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the palette subdued. Visual refresh: a loose hoodie under a bright track jacket with large noise-cancelling headphones.
